description: when is an optional that is none when its test is false and runs its expression only when the test holds; do runs its steps in order and returns the last, which may recur.
program: (let [item (call store.get {:id "a"}) big (when (> (get item :size) 5) (get (call store.get {:id "b"}) :size)) small (when (< (get item :size) 5) (get (call store.get {:id "c"}) :size)) kept (keep (fn [id] (when (not= id "b") (str id "!"))) ["a" "b" "c"])] (do (call store.put {:id "z" :size 1}) (loop {:max 3} [i 0] (do (call store.put {:id "l" :size i}) (if (< i 1) (recur (+ i 1)) {:big big :small small :kept kept :i i})))))
